mapper.select: SELECT product_id AS productId, category_id AS categoryId, supplier_id AS supplierId, product_name AS productName, description, is_customizable AS isCustomizable, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, status AS status FROM products WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY product_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( category_id, supplier_id, product_name, description, is_customizable, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{supplierId}, #{productName}, #{description}, #{isCustomizable}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
